text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro-driverless thesis and repeated stance throughout","quality":"clear position","description":"The essay states an arguable claim early and keeps its support aligned with that position from start to finish."},{"evidence":"“The text states…” followed by explanation of fuel, flexibility, and safety","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay consistently draws on details from the article and connects them to its argument."},{"evidence":"several paragraphs each built around a separate reason","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct points that make the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“A counter argument … is the law” and discussion of fault","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible objection and briefly addresses it instead of ignoring it."},{"evidence":"“pollution,” “safety,” and “quality of life” as supporting points","quality":"development of reasoning","description":"The essay explains why its evidence matters rather than just restating facts from the article."}]}
